sections.description:
PRIVATISATION COMMISSION (DELEGATION
PRIVATISATION
COMMISSION (DELEGATION
OF POWERS)
REGULATIONS, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part II, 25th November, 2002]
S.R.O. 832(I)/2002, dated
20-11-2002.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 41 of the
Privatization Commission Ordinance, 2000 (LII of 2000) read with section 9 (2)
thereof, the Privatization Commission hereby makes the following Regulations
namely:
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) These Regulations may be called the Privatisation
Commission (Delegation of Powers) Regulations, 2002.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In
these Regulations, unless there is any thing repugnant in the subject or
context:-
(a) "Ordinance" means
the Privatisation Commission Ordinance 2000 (LII of 2000):
(b) "delegation of
powers" means the extent of powers indicated in the Schedule;
(c) "Schedule" means
the Schedule. attached to these Regulations;
(2) All other terms and
expressions used, but not defined in these Regulations shall have the same meaning
as assigned to them in the Ordinance or Rules or Regulations notified under the
Ordinance from time to time.
3. Delegation of Powers.------(1)
The Chairman. Secretary and officers of the Commission shall perform the
functions or exercise the powers a delegated and subject to the conditions
specified in the Schedule to these Regulations.
(2) In case the Chairman is not
available at principal office .in Islamabad, the Secretary shall perform his
functions or exercise the powers on his behalf provided that such cases shall
be submitted to the Chairman on his return to the principal office, for
information.
(3) In case the Secretary is not
available at principal office in Islamabad, the Executive Director or the
Director-General, as the case, may be, may submit the cases if the situation so
warrants, to the Chairman for decision. Such cases shall be submitted to the
Secretary on his return to the principal office for information.
(4) Where the powers have been
delegated to the Chairman or the Secretary the Board or the Chairman may review
the case where considered necessary.
(5) Where the powers have been
delegated to any other officer. Chairman or Secretary may review the case where
considered necessary.
(6) The powers delegated shall be
exercised by the respective authorities subject to observance of other rules,
regulations notifications, orders, instructions in force within the meaning of
subsection (4) of section 3 of the Ordinance or those prescribed/ issued under
various sections of the Ordinance.
(7) The powers delegate as per
said Schedule shall not be further delegated by the respective officers to
their subordinates except with the prior approval of the Board.
(8) Approval/decision of the
Board shall be' obtained in the following cases: -
(i) Constitution of
pre-qualification Committee
(ii) Pre-qualification criteria
for pre-qualification of the prospective bidders
(iii) Pre-qualification of
bidders
(iv) Transaction Structure and
modification thereof for all modes of privatisation
(v) Joint Audit Review
(vi) Sale of remaining shares in
respect of privatized enterprises
(vii) Licensing and tariff rules
of regulatory authorities, where such rules may affect the privatisation
programme
(viii) Panel of Chartered
Accountants to carry out audit of Privatisation Commission
(ix) Audited Accounts of
Privatisation Commission.
(x) Panel of Values
(xi) Panel of Lawyers/Law Firms
(xii) Change in the existing
scale of fee for Lawyers/Law firms on the panel
(xiii) Panel of Lead Managers
(xiv) Appointment of Financial
Adviser in specific transactions
(9) Approval/decision of the
Chairman shall be obtained in the following cases: -
(i) Incentives to employees of PC
to undertake special workload not falling within the normal sphere of their
duties
(ii) Financial Advisory Services
Agreement
(iii) Bid documents ,
(iv) Sale instruments'
(v) Letter of Acceptance
(vi) Distribution of
privatisation proceeds
